description: MainActivity.java is the primary activity class for an Android application demonstrating fingerprint authentication and cryptographic key handling with the Android Keystore. It manages UI interactions, key creation, and fingerprint authentication dialogs.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity handling fingerprint setup, cryptographic key creation, and user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, checks device security setup, creates cryptographic keys, and sets up button interactions.

methods.name: initSignature
methods.description: Initializes the Signature object with the generated private key for signing operations.

methods.name: onPurchased
methods.description: Callback invoked upon successful purchase, displays confirmation.

methods.name: onPurchaseFailed
methods.description: Callback invoked if purchase fails, shows a toast message.

methods.name: showConfirmation
methods.description: Displays a confirmation message and shows encrypted data if available.

methods.name: createKeyPair
methods.description: Generates an EC key pair in the Android Keystore with user authentication required.
